# World-class science. Life-changing impact.

Get an inside look at the work we do every day to define what's possible and transform patients'
lives through science.

[ see what drives us ][68]

## Life + Science

[ view more stories ][69]

## Areas of focus
* [
  
  ### Oncology
  
  Building on our heritage in the treatment of solid tumors, we’re solving complex scientific
  problems for cancer patients everywhere.
  
  Learn more about Oncology ][70]
* [
  
  ### Hematology
  
  Known for delivering many transformational firsts in hematology, we’re committed to breaking new
  ground across diseases with high unmet need.
  
  Learn more about Hematology ][71]
* [
  
  ### Neuroscience
  
  We’re dedicated to championing the needs and experiences of people living with neurological and
  psychiatric diseases through disease-modifying and symptomatic therapies.
  
  Learn more about neuroscience ][72]
* [
  
  ### Immunology
  
  We’re working to deliver meaningful solutions that address unmet needs in dermatology,
  gastroenterology, pulmonology and rheumatology.
  
  Learn more about immunology ][73]
* [
  
  ### Cardiovascular
  
  Building on a 70-year legacy of paradigm-changing medicines, we’re leveraging our experience and
  expertise to take cardiovascular research to the next level.
  
  Learn more about cardiovascular ][74]

[ View more ][75]

## Pipeline

AS OF APRIL 30, 2026
* 50 Compounds in development
* 40+ Disease areas being studied

Our pipeline targets areas where we can deliver transformative medicines — for patients who need
them most.

# World-class science. Life-changing impact.

Get an inside look at the work we do every day to define what's possible and transform patients'
lives through science.

[ see what drives us ][68]

## Life + Science

[ view more stories ][69]

## Areas of focus
* [
  
  ### Oncology
  
  Building on our heritage in the treatment of solid tumors, we’re solving complex scientific
  problems for cancer patients everywhere.
  
  Learn more about Oncology ][70]
* [
  
  ### Hematology
  
  Known for delivering many transformational firsts in hematology, we’re committed to breaking new
  ground across diseases with high unmet need.
  
  Learn more about Hematology ][71]
* [
  
  ### Neuroscience
  
  We’re dedicated to championing the needs and experiences of people living with neurological and
  psychiatric diseases through disease-modifying and symptomatic therapies.
  
  Learn more about neuroscience ][72]
* [
  
  ### Immunology
  
  We’re working to deliver meaningful solutions that address unmet needs in dermatology,
  gastroenterology, pulmonology and rheumatology.
  
  Learn more about immunology ][73]
* [
  
  ### Cardiovascular
  
  Building on a 70-year legacy of paradigm-changing medicines, we’re leveraging our experience and
  expertise to take cardiovascular research to the next level.
  
  Learn more about cardiovascular ][74]

[ View more ][75]

them most.

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

[All Early Phase Clinical Services][140]

## At the Speed of Science

Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories in Lincoln, NE and Zurich, Switzerland are equipped with the
latest technologies for PK, immunogenicity, and biomarker assays to provide regulated support at all
phases of drug development.

[Learn More][147]

## Bioanalytical Sciences

For over 40 years, Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories have provided end-to-end support for drug
developers from pre-clinical through late-stage clinical testing. Learn how our experienced
scientific teams can provide custom, phase-appropriate bioanalytical solutions for your program.

## The Future of Pharmacy

We’ve got our eyes set on the future. We’re taking research higher, discoveries further, and
translating science into medicine day by day.

[Learn More][155]

## Therapeutic Expertise Areas

### Focused on Strong Science and Flawless Execution

Between our comprehensive services and decades of therapeutic experience, we have the expertise to
handle every aspect of your product’s early development—no matter the type of drug or clinical
trial. These are some of the many specialties we’ve cultivated over the years, to provide fast,
innovative solutions for your drug’s development.

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

## At the Speed of Science

Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories in Lincoln, NE and Zurich, Switzerland are equipped with the
latest technologies for PK, immunogenicity, and biomarker assays to provide regulated support at all
phases of drug development.

[Learn More][147]

## Bioanalytical Sciences

For over 40 years, Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories have provided end-to-end support for drug
developers from pre-clinical through late-stage clinical testing. Learn how our experienced
scientific teams can provide custom, phase-appropriate bioanalytical solutions for your program.

## Therapeutic Expertise Areas

### Focused on Strong Science and Flawless Execution

Between our comprehensive services and decades of therapeutic experience, we have the expertise to
handle every aspect of your product’s early development—no matter the type of drug or clinical
trial. These are some of the many specialties we’ve cultivated over the years, to provide fast,

[More][106]
[

### Vision

We strive to transform Fresenius Kabi in the decade to come. We are committed to increase
efficiencies in the therapy and care of patients and improve access to high-quality healthcare
around the globe.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][107]
[

### Excellence

We are specialized in lifesaving medicines and technologies for critically and chronically ill
patients. With our passion and expertise, we touch the lives of almost 450 million people every
year, each one representing the importance of our work.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][108]
[

### Sustainability

We constantly strive to improve our sustainability footprint. For us, meeting the needs of patients
and healthcare professionals goes hand in hand with responsible and ethical management.

    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]

    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable

    cancer and specialty care.

    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.

    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

Our strategy

Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation
(MIDC) in close vicinity to manufacturing locations.

  Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals and also produces Formulations with its wholly-owned subsidiary

## gene therapies for serious diseases. Abeona’s ZEVASKYN^{®} (prademagene zamikeracel) was approved

## facility in Cleveland, Ohio serves as the manufacturing site for ZEVASKYN commercial production.

## engineered T-cell therapy targeting Prostate-Specific Membrane Antigen (PSMA), engineered to
## overcome the core failures of cell therapies in solid tumors.

# Transforming lives through the promise of genetic medicine

[Learn More][39]

## **Abeona Therapeutics Inc.** is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company developing cell and
## gene therapies for serious diseases. Abeona’s ZEVASKYN^{®} (prademagene zamikeracel) was approved
## in April of 2025. The Company’s fully integrated cell and gene therapy cGMP manufacturing
## facility in Cleveland, Ohio serves as the manufacturing site for ZEVASKYN commercial production.
## The Company’s development portfolio features PSMA-SIR-T^{™}, a potentially first-in-class
## engineered T-cell therapy targeting Prostate-Specific Membrane Antigen (PSMA), engineered to
## overcome the core failures of cell therapies in solid tumors.

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

[⟶][114]
[

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]
[

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs. 

[⟶][118]
[

### Our CDMO Services

][119]

We offer fully integrated **CDMO services **covering the entire process: from initial planning and
supply chain management to regulatory affairs, for your drug product.

[⟶][120]

## Our Network

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

services.

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

ARM unites the cell and gene therapy ecosystem to modernize healthcare systems, overcome obstacles
to innovation, and improve patient access to life-changing treatments.

[ Join ARM ][119]
[Hero Illustration] [Mobile Hero Illustration]

ARM is where the CGT sector converges to solve its most pressing challenges. We unite a
multistakeholder community of biotechnology companies, research institutions, patient advocates, and
strategic suppliers to shape regulation and policy, unlock access, and accelerate transformative
therapies.

[ Learn More About ARM ][120]
[Cell, gene, and tissue-based therapeutics]

### Cell, gene, and tissue-based therapeutics

We support our members in advancing living medicines that target the root causes of
disease—therapies that repair or replace cells and genes to durably treat and potentially cure a

We applaud Congress for passing ARM’s top two legislative priorities and are grateful to our partner

[ Read ARM's Statement ][121]
[ARM Applauds Passage of the Mikaela Naylon Give Kids a Chance Act and the Accelerating Kids Access

## Membership Benefits

Join a global community collaborating to shape the future of CGT through advocacy, networking, and
scientific engagement. Together, we have the power to advance the sector and improve patients'
lives.

Already a member? [ Login to Portal [Arrow right] ][122]
[Influence]

### Influence

Participate in forums and advisory groups that develop positions on scientific, regulatory, access,
and reimbursement policies.

[Networking]

### Networking

Engage with the community via ARM’s member portal, events, workshops, and working groups to build
strategic relationships across the CGT sector.

[Capital Formation]

### Capital Formation

Access exclusive investor relations tools and attend member-only webinars and events to strengthen
your relationship with investors.

[Exposure]

### Exposure

Elevate your visibility in the CGT community through sponsorship and networking opportunities and
member-exclusive speaking and leadership roles.

development, including preclinical safety testing, clinical pharmacology (Phase I to Phase II),

Focused on your success … always available and always looking ahead ... moving in unison to deliver
big impact with a personal touch.

We help you reach early phase drug development decision-making milestones sooner, improving speed
and ease from lead candidate selection to proof of concept, and beyond.

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

## Follow us and keep up to date

## Partner with us for the advancement of life-altering genetic therapies for patients, and for
## shaping a healthier world.

Substantiated by decades of pioneering research, closeness to patients, and the production of over
500 GMP batches of viral vector therapies for rare diseases, along with the origin of a currently
approved gene therapy, Andelyn Biosciences is a proven and reliable full-service cell and gene
therapy CDMO with deep scientific and manufacturing expertise and a track record of success.

## Empowering Breakthroughs, Enhancing Lives.

### A Journey of Innovation and Growth

Andelyn Biosciences is driven by its mission of accelerating the development and manufacturing of
innovative therapies to bring more treatments to more patients. Our dedication to scientific
excellence, collaborative partnerships, and reliable manufacturing reflects our commitment to meet
the current needs of the industry and to anticipate and shape its future. Through tech transfer of
established processes or the adoption of our data-driven and program-specific
Optimization-By-Design™ AAV Curator® Platform, together we strive to overcome the greatest
challenges in gene therapy: enabling our partners to deliver life-changing treatments to those in
need.

Our journey is a testament to our enduring commitment to advancing healthcare. Discover the
milestones and achievements that have shaped our vision of Turning Hope Into Reality™.

Explore Our History
][38]

Substantiated by decades of pioneering research, closeness to patients, and the production of over
500 GMP batches of viral vector therapies for rare diseases, along with the origin of a currently

therapy CDMO with deep scientific and manufacturing expertise and a track record of success.

### A Journey of Innovation and Growth

Andelyn Biosciences is driven by its mission of accelerating the development and manufacturing of
innovative therapies to bring more treatments to more patients. Our dedication to scientific
excellence, collaborative partnerships, and reliable manufacturing reflects our commitment to meet
the current needs of the industry and to anticipate and shape its future. Through tech transfer of
established processes or the adoption of our data-driven and program-specific
Optimization-By-Design™ AAV Curator® Platform, together we strive to overcome the greatest
challenges in gene therapy: enabling our partners to deliver life-changing treatments to those in
need.

Our journey is a testament to our enduring commitment to advancing healthcare. Discover the
milestones and achievements that have shaped our vision of Turning Hope Into Reality™.

These facilities are benchmarked to international standards and set to meet the rigorous quality
guideline, which is critical in achieving our global growth aspirations.

As a leading API supplier, our regulatory-approved facilities enable us to supply our partners all
over countries with a broad portfolio of products. Our expertise spans a variety of chemical
processes, Heterocyclic chemistry, Carbohydrates chemistry. Additionally, we manage enzyme
conversions for some of our products. Our manufacturing capacity for various categories ranges from
500MT/year to 800MT/Year.

# A Focus on...

Join the American Society of Gene & Cell Therapy to connect with a global community dedicated to
advancing genetic and cellular therapies to alleviate human disease.

[ Join ASGCT ][151] [ About Us ][152]

## Advancing Knowledge, Awareness, and Education of Cell and Gene Therapies

Discover upcoming events and opportunities to advance your knowledge, build connections, and propel
the field forward.

### Introducing the ASGCT Foundation

This charitable nonprofit is dedicated to ensuring that the life-changing potential of gene and cell
therapy reaches every patient.

[ Learn More ][153]

### GME Bootcamp

This focused, one-day bootcamp is designed to prepare the next generation of clinicians to safely
and effectively integrate cell and gene therapies into patient care.

[ Join Us August 21 ][154]

### Policy Summit

Collaborate on innovative solutions with your colleagues at this dynamic, one-day event on September
14 in Washington, D.C.

[ Details ][155]

### GME Bootcamp

This focused, one-day bootcamp is designed to prepare the next generation of clinicians to safely
and effectively integrate cell and gene therapies into patient care.

[ Join Us August 21 ][157]

### Policy Summit

Collaborate on innovative solutions with your colleagues at this dynamic, one-day event on September
14 in Washington, D.C.

[ Details ][158]

## At the Forefront of the Cell and Gene Therapy Industry

Become a part of the largest and most inclusive cell and gene therapy community, including top
researchers and clinicians from academia and bio-industry working alongside patients, families, and
advocates.

### CGTxchange

We've partnered with the Orphan Therapeutics Accelerator to create a dedicated clearinghouse and
marketplace designed to catalyze the development of cell and gene therapies that have been shelved
due to economic or strategic shifts.

[ Explore Now ][159]
Podcasts

### ASGCT Podcast Network

Find insightful interviews, riveting conversations, and incredible discoveries on the ASGCT Podcast
Network. Listen to the latest episodes of the Molecular Therapy Podcast, Giants of Gene Therapy, and
The Issue.

[ Listen ][160]
Collaborations

### Partner with ASGCT

ASGCT offers year-round advertising, sponsorship, and talent recruitment opportunities to help you
meet your marketing and strategic goals.

[ Get Started ][161]

### ASGCT Foundation

The ASGCT Foundation is a charitable nonprofit organization dedicated to ensuring that the
life-changing potential of gene and cell therapy reaches every patient. By addressing resource
scarcity and systemic barriers, the Foundation works to bridge the gap between scientific discovery
and patient delivery. 

[ Learn More ][162]

# A Focus on...

Join the American Society of Gene & Cell Therapy to connect with a global community dedicated to
advancing genetic and cellular therapies to alleviate human disease.

[ Join ASGCT ][151] [ About Us ][152]

## Advancing Knowledge, Awareness, and Education of Cell and Gene Therapies

Discover upcoming events and opportunities to advance your knowledge, build connections, and propel
the field forward.

### Introducing the ASGCT Foundation

This charitable nonprofit is dedicated to ensuring that the life-changing potential of gene and cell
therapy reaches every patient.

[ Learn More ][153]

### GME Bootcamp

This focused, one-day bootcamp is designed to prepare the next generation of clinicians to safely
and effectively integrate cell and gene therapies into patient care.

[ Join Us August 21 ][154]

### Policy Summit

Collaborate on innovative solutions with your colleagues at this dynamic, one-day event on September
14 in Washington, D.C.

## At the Forefront of the Cell and Gene Therapy Industry

Become a part of the largest and most inclusive cell and gene therapy community, including top
researchers and clinicians from academia and bio-industry working alongside patients, families, and
advocates.

### CGTxchange

We've partnered with the Orphan Therapeutics Accelerator to create a dedicated clearinghouse and
marketplace designed to catalyze the development of cell and gene therapies that have been shelved
due to economic or strategic shifts.

[ Explore Now ][159]
Podcasts

### ASGCT Podcast Network

Find insightful interviews, riveting conversations, and incredible discoveries on the ASGCT Podcast
Network. Listen to the latest episodes of the Molecular Therapy Podcast, Giants of Gene Therapy, and
The Issue.

[ Listen ][160]

### Partner with ASGCT

ASGCT offers year-round advertising, sponsorship, and talent recruitment opportunities to help you
meet your marketing and strategic goals.

[ Get Started ][161]

The ASGCT Foundation is a charitable nonprofit organization dedicated to ensuring that the
life-changing potential of gene and cell therapy reaches every patient. By addressing resource
scarcity and systemic barriers, the Foundation works to bridge the gap between scientific discovery
and patient delivery.

# We are Life Couriers. Logistics for Life.

Life Couriers (formerly Associated Couriers) is a global group of specialized logistics service
providers, focused on life science and healthcare logistics. We deliver life-saving diagnostics and
therapies all over the world. **Patient focused. Local service. Global reach. **We are LOGISTICS FOR
LIFE.

## Leaders in Healthcare and Life Science Logistics

From the transit request for pick up through delivery, we provide ***Logistics for Life!*** Our
company-owned fleet of vehicles, combined with our logistics database of trusted carriers, means
that we can ensure our customers are the primary focus.

# UNLEASHING THE PROMISE OF T-CELL THERAPIES.

[ DISCOVER ATARA ][44]

## Cutting-edge science. A fresh approach.

Atara is an allogeneic T-cell immunotherapy company. We're harnessing the natural biology of T
cells—our body’s most effective weapon in fighting disease—to develop transformative therapies for
patients with cancer and autoimmune conditions.
* #### Off-the-shelf approach
  
  Allogeneic T-cell therapies can be readily available for rapid delivery within days.
* #### Scalable manufacturing
  
  Efficient, robust process with the ability to produce over a thousand doses from one healthy
  donor.
* #### Highly versatile platform
  
  Potential application for a wide range of disease-causing viral and non-viral targets.
[OUR TECHNOLOGY][45]

## We’re developing a pipeline of firsts.

Our investigational T-cell therapies target difficult-to-treat cancers and autoimmune conditions
that can be rapidly delivered to patients from inventory. We’re the first company ever to receive an
approval for an allogeneic T-cell immunotherapy.

[ Our Pipeline ][46]

# UNLEASHING THE PROMISE OF T-CELL THERAPIES.

[ DISCOVER ATARA ][44]

## Cutting-edge science. A fresh approach.

Atara is an allogeneic T-cell immunotherapy company. We're harnessing the natural biology of T
cells—our body’s most effective weapon in fighting disease—to develop transformative therapies for
patients with cancer and autoimmune conditions.
* #### Off-the-shelf approach
  
  Allogeneic T-cell therapies can be readily available for rapid delivery within days.
* #### Scalable manufacturing
  
  Efficient, robust process with the ability to produce over a thousand doses from one healthy
  donor.
* #### Highly versatile platform
  
  Potential application for a wide range of disease-causing viral and non-viral targets.
[OUR TECHNOLOGY][45]

## We’re developing a pipeline of firsts.

Our investigational T-cell therapies target difficult-to-treat cancers and autoimmune conditions
that can be rapidly delivered to patients from inventory. We’re the first company ever to receive an
approval for an allogeneic T-cell immunotherapy.

## Experts in temperature-controlled shipping

From the moment your consignment leaves, you need to know it is in the hands of experts who can
deliver reliable temperature-controlled shipping.

We know that flawless execution is essential in every aspect of logistics. From choosing the most
efficient transport route, to evaluating, validating and implementing the most appropriate
packaging, Biocair understands that effective logistics solutions are absolutely vital to maintain
the integrity of your precious materials.

With Biocair, it’s never just about moving a shipment from A to B — it’s about **building logistics
around your needs**. Every shipment represents months of work, critical research, and ultimately,
patient lives. That’s why our global experts take a proactive, flexible, and accountable approach at
every stage — anticipating risks, navigating complex regulations, and adapting to changing
conditions to ensure your materials arrive exactly as intended, every time.

## Experts in temperature-controlled shipping

From the moment your consignment leaves, you need to know it is in the hands of experts who can
deliver reliable temperature-controlled shipping.

We know that flawless execution is essential in every aspect of logistics. From choosing the most
efficient transport route, to evaluating, validating and implementing the most appropriate
packaging, Biocair understands that effective logistics solutions are absolutely vital to maintain
the integrity of your precious materials.

With Biocair, it’s never just about moving a shipment from A to B — it’s about **building logistics
around your needs**. Every shipment represents months of work, critical research, and ultimately,
patient lives. That’s why our global experts take a proactive, flexible, and accountable approach at
every stage — anticipating risks, navigating complex regulations, and adapting to changing
conditions to ensure your materials arrive exactly as intended, every time.

[ebola]

## Supporting Ebola Response: Rapid Diagnostics and Global Expertise

Advancing our commitment to public health, our teams are partnering to actively support Ebola
response efforts on the ground, expand diagnostic testing and strengthen laboratory capabilities.

[ Explore the Ebola Resource Hub ][207]

## Protecting Food. Protecting People.

Safe food isn't just a privilege; it is a necessity. An estimated 600 million people fall ill after
eating contaminated food annually, with approximately 420,000 losing their lives. Efficient,
reliable and fast diagnostic solutions play a crucial role in safety, quality and protecting
consumers worldwide.

[ Discover Food & Quality Safety Solutions ][208]

## Annual Report: Achievements Building a Healthier Future

bioMérieux’s Annual Report highlights the achievements shaping public health, innovation, and
environmental responsibility for our future. From strengthening the fight against AMR and sepsis to
accelerating sustainable solutions, our work continues driving better outcomes for people, our
communities and the planet.

[ Explore the 2025 Annual Report ][209]
[Elevating Education Across the Diagnostic Pathway]

## Elevating Education Across the Diagnostic Pathway

The newly launched Product Education Hub deepens diagnostic understanding with evidence‑based
resources. Leverage scientific materials, webinars, symposium highlights, case studies, and more to
drive more informed clinical decision‑making.

[ Discover the Hub ][210]

## [ bioMérieux Launches PCR Testing Solution to Verify Probiotic Species in Dietary Supplements
## Manufacturing ][211]

With GENE-UP® PROBIOTIC SPECIES ID, bioMérieux introduces a first-of-its-kind commercialized
species-level identification PCR solution for in-house quality control teams and external laboratory
partners.
[ Discover more ][212]

Swipe for more stories
* ## [ bioMérieux submits 510(k) to U.S. FDA for the latest versions of the BIOFIRE® FILMARRAY®
  ## Gastrointestinal Panels to enhance detection of gastrointestinal pathogens ][213]
  
  bioMérieux, a world leader in the field of in vitro diagnostics, today announces the submission of
  the BIOFIRE® FILMARRAY® Gastrointestinal 1.1 (GI1.1) Panel and the BIOFIRE® FILMARRAY®
  Gastrointestinal 1.1 (GI1.1) Panel Mid to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for 510(k)
  review. These PCR* molecular panels test 22 and 11, respectively, of the most common bacteria,
  viruses, and parasites associated with gastroenteritis, all from one sample, with results
  available in approximately one hour.
  [ Discover more ][214]
* ## [ Advancing Women’s Health with Rapid Diagnostics: bioMérieux files a Dual 510(k) /CLIA Waiver
  ## application to the FDA for the BIOFIRE® SPOTFIRE® Vaginitis Panel ][215]
  
  bioMérieux, a world leader in the field of in vitro diagnostics, has submitted a Dual 510(k)/CLIA
  Waiver application to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for the BIOFIRE® SPOTFIRE®
  Vaginitis (VG) Panel. This automated, multiplex PCR test can simultaneously detect the most common
  causes of vaginitis in 20 minutes, directly at the point of care. With this submission, bioMérieux
  is intending to expand into women’s and sexual health, bringing rapid and accurate diagnostics
  closer to patients.
  [ Discover more ][216]
* ## [ bioMérieux introduces Salmonella testing kit on GENE-UP® TYPER to support root cause analysis
  ## in the food industry ][217]
  
  bioMérieux, a world leader in the field of in vitro diagnostics, today introduces the launch of
  GENE-UP® TYPER SLM, a new real-time PCR solution supporting rapid root cause analysis by
  discriminating Salmonella in the food industry environments.
  [ Discover more ][218]

## Protecting Food. Protecting People.

Safe food isn't just a privilege; it is a necessity. An estimated 600 million people fall ill after
eating contaminated food annually, with approximately 420,000 losing their lives. Efficient,
reliable and fast diagnostic solutions play a crucial role in safety, quality and protecting
consumers worldwide.

bioMérieux’s Annual Report highlights the achievements shaping public health, innovation, and
environmental responsibility for our future. From strengthening the fight against AMR and sepsis to
accelerating sustainable solutions, our work continues driving better outcomes for people, our
communities and the planet.

  bioMérieux, a world leader in the field of in vitro diagnostics, today announces the submission of
  the BIOFIRE® FILMARRAY® Gastrointestinal 1.1 (GI1.1) Panel and the BIOFIRE® FILMARRAY®
  Gastrointestinal 1.1 (GI1.1) Panel Mid to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for 510(k)

  available in approximately one hour.

  Waiver application to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for the BIOFIRE® SPOTFIRE®
  Vaginitis (VG) Panel. This automated, multiplex PCR test can simultaneously detect the most common
  causes of vaginitis in 20 minutes, directly at the point of care. With this submission, bioMérieux

  closer to patients.

# Driving partner success with reliable, expert-driven CDMO services

At Bora Pharmaceuticals, it is our shared responsibility to execute every drug program reliably on
time, consistently in full.

[ Get in touch today ][54]

## A global pharmaceutical manufacturing partner
* From sites in North America and Asia, Bora delivers reliable, high-quality drug products to 100+
  markets around the globe

Bora Pharmaceuticals is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO)
specializing in formulation development, clinical and commercial cGMP manufacturing, and packaging
of complex oral solid dose, liquid, semi-solid, biologic, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical
products.

From our nine cGMP facilities across three countries, Bora Pharmaceuticals delivers drug products
with unparalleled quality to more than 100 markets around the world. Bora’s teams, technologies, and
facilities work seamlessly together with a shared commitment to supporting partners, minimizing
risk, and helping ensure therapies reach patients worldwide.

# Driving partner success with reliable, expert-driven CDMO services

At Bora Pharmaceuticals, it is our shared responsibility to execute every drug program reliably on
time, consistently in full.

[ Get in touch today ][54]

## A global pharmaceutical manufacturing partner
* From sites in North America and Asia, Bora delivers reliable, high-quality drug products to 100+
  markets around the globe

Bora Pharmaceuticals is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO)
specializing in formulation development, clinical and commercial cGMP manufacturing, and packaging
of complex oral solid dose, liquid, semi-solid, biologic, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical
products.

From our nine cGMP facilities across three countries, Bora Pharmaceuticals delivers drug products
with unparalleled quality to more than 100 markets around the world. Bora’s teams, technologies, and
facilities work seamlessly together with a shared commitment to supporting partners, minimizing
risk, and helping ensure therapies reach patients worldwide.

## 2nd Cell & Gene Therapy Global Congress 2024 Europe

The Fastest Growing Cell & Gene Therapy Networking Event. 
* Introduction
* Insight
* Who Should Attend

Cell and Gene therapies are forms of personalised, regenerative medicine. Described as the most
innovative, promising and life-changing new categories of medicines whose full potential is only
just beginning to emerge. They are cutting-edge and rapidly progressing fields of Biological
Therapies. Also known as “Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products”, they involved the use of cells,
tissues and genes to treat, prevent or potentially cure and eliminate complicated health conditions
and difficult to treat diseases. These therapies promise life-changing treatments for a broad
spectrum of complex diseases ranging from genetic conditions to cancers. Both approaches offer the
potential to diminish the fundamental cause of genetic and acquired diseases by substituting the
missing protein or cells causing the disease’s symptoms. Cell and gene therapies may offer longer
lasting effects than traditional medicines. Convergence of advanced biotechnology, precision
medicine, and expertise in manufacturing has facilitated the way for these therapies to become a
reality, with remarkable successes observed in conditions such as cancer and genetic disorders.

Cell and Gene therapy has transformed the healthcare and biopharma industry by storm. Currently,
after around 40 CGT launches across the EU and US, the market is worth around EUR 4.5 billion. A
similar number are expected to be approved by 2028, when sales are projected to rise to EUR 19.2
billion. The development of biological therapies is rapidly expanding, however, commercialisation of
this treatment poses different challenges to research and development, authorisation, manufacturing,
accessibility, and ensuring safety throughout the lifecycle of the product.

The two-day Congress will provide an interactive, cutting edge, and comprehensive discussions in
collaborative format led by key experts with intimate knowledge in the industry. Gain practical
strategies and best practices on challenges, innovations, technologies, and concepts to help you
gain access to the booming CGT market.

We are putting together an agenda that focuses on “driving innovation, addressing significant unmet
medical needs, and ultimately improving patient outcomes”.

We are gathering high calibre expert speakers to participate and share their knowledge and expertise
through Keynote Presentations and Panel discussions, addressing all aspects of the industry.

We look forward to welcoming you to the **CGT World Congress 2024!**

Sincerely yours,
Jocelyn Raguindin
Conference Director

## [ ERIC HALIOUA ][62]

President & Chief Executive Officer

PDC*line Pharma

## ERIC HALIOUA

President & Chief Executive Officer

Serial entrepreneur that combines strong strategic, technological and managerial experience with
proven track record of deal-making and fund-raising. During his career he achieved together with his
different teams to bring four drug candidates from research to the clinics (up to phase IIb).
Overall, Eric has raised as of now a total of more than €160 million from VCs and strategic partners
in Europe, USA, Japan and Korea and have had numerous successes in the sale and initial public
offering of biotechnology companies. He is CEO of the biotechnology company PDC*line Pharma and
board member of Essenscia (Bio.be). Eric is co-founder of four biotechnology companies called Myosix
(bought by Genzyme mid-2002), Murigenetics, HairClone and Digital Orthopaedics. He is co-Inventor of
the first GMP approved mobile manufacturing unit for cell therapy. Eric worked for 12 years in the
Healthcare and Life Sciences Practice of Arthur D. Little. Eric holds two master’s degrees in
pharmacology and Molecular Biology and a MBA from ESSEC business school (Paris, France), with an
advanced degree from the Health Care ESSEC chair.
[
][63]

## [ Jeff Liter ][64]

CEO

OX2 Therapeutics

## Jeff Liter

CEO

Jeff is a seasoned CEO with a proven track record at profitably growing emerging companies and
business divisions. He has raised over $15M in seed capital from angel investors to start four
different companies which he then led to becoming profitable or acquired. Jeff got his start in Cell
therapy as the Chief Operating Officer of Progenitor Cell Therapy (PCT) where he supported over 25
clinical trials in the Cell and Gene Therapy field. These trials ranged from Phase I to Phase III
pivotal trials. Some highlights include: Responsible for tech transferring Kite’s T-Cell therapy out
of the NIH, Novartis’ cell therapy out of UPenn and Adaptimmume’s cell therapy out of UPenn. Led
B-MoGen Biotechnologies to develop TcBuster the first industry wide transposon tool for the cell
therapy space. Has led Luminary Therapeutics to an approved Phase I IND for Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma
with a novel ligand CAR that has three distinct antigens – directed to overcome the 25% patient
relapse rates due to antigen escape. Has led OX2 Therapeutics to a Phase I clinical trial for
recurrent Glioblastoma.
[
][65]

## [ Alex Blyth ][66]

Founder & CEO

Lift Biosciences

## Alex Blyth

Founder & CEO

Serial entrepreneur and inventor with a background in biology and economics. Alex is a serial
entrepreneur and inventor with a background in biology and economics. With 20 years of biopharma
experience, Alex has been instrumental in bringing first-in-class assets like T-Vec, Erbitux, and
Abraxane to market. Previously, he served as Managing Director of Cello Business Sciences and
Vice-President of Cello Health Consulting. Founded LIfT BioSciences after losing his mother to
pancreatic cancer and promising his daughter they would stop other little girls losing their
grandmothers. The company builds on the research of leading immunologists Prof. Zheng Cui and Dr.
Lloyd J. Old, who identified defective neutrophils in cancer patients and demonstrated their
correction could lead to tumour remission. LIfT BioSciences has developed a new area of science
where neutrophils serve as the backbone of an effective immune system. LIfT has developed
Immuno-modulatory Alpha Neutrophils (IMANs), which infiltrate solid tumors, modulate the tumour
microenvironment, and recruit other immune cells to destroy tumours with enhanced persistence and
proliferation. The company is entering Phase 1 clinical trials for their Immuno-Cell Therapy
Platform and is exploring other therapeutic modalities, including treatments for auto-immune
diseases, neurological conditions, and infectious diseases.
[
][67]

EUCOPE

## 2nd Cell & Gene Therapy Global Congress 2024 Europe

The Fastest Growing Cell & Gene Therapy Networking Event. 
* Introduction
* Insight
* Who Should Attend

Cell and Gene therapies are forms of personalised, regenerative medicine. Described as the most
innovative, promising and life-changing new categories of medicines whose full potential is only
just beginning to emerge. They are cutting-edge and rapidly progressing fields of Biological
Therapies. Also known as “Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products”, they involved the use of cells,
tissues and genes to treat, prevent or potentially cure and eliminate complicated health conditions
and difficult to treat diseases. These therapies promise life-changing treatments for a broad
spectrum of complex diseases ranging from genetic conditions to cancers. Both approaches offer the
potential to diminish the fundamental cause of genetic and acquired diseases by substituting the
missing protein or cells causing the disease’s symptoms. Cell and gene therapies may offer longer
lasting effects than traditional medicines. Convergence of advanced biotechnology, precision
medicine, and expertise in manufacturing has facilitated the way for these therapies to become a
reality, with remarkable successes observed in conditions such as cancer and genetic disorders.

Cell and Gene therapy has transformed the healthcare and biopharma industry by storm. Currently,
after around 40 CGT launches across the EU and US, the market is worth around EUR 4.5 billion. A
similar number are expected to be approved by 2028, when sales are projected to rise to EUR 19.2
billion. The development of biological therapies is rapidly expanding, however, commercialisation of
this treatment poses different challenges to research and development, authorisation, manufacturing,
accessibility, and ensuring safety throughout the lifecycle of the product.

The two-day Congress will provide an interactive, cutting edge, and comprehensive discussions in
collaborative format led by key experts with intimate knowledge in the industry. Gain practical
strategies and best practices on challenges, innovations, technologies, and concepts to help you
gain access to the booming CGT market.

We are putting together an agenda that focuses on “driving innovation, addressing significant unmet
medical needs, and ultimately improving patient outcomes”.

We are gathering high calibre expert speakers to participate and share their knowledge and expertise
through Keynote Presentations and Panel discussions, addressing all aspects of the industry.

We look forward to welcoming you to the **CGT World Congress 2024!**

Sincerely yours,
Jocelyn Raguindin
Conference Director

## [ ERIC HALIOUA ][62]

President & Chief Executive Officer

PDC*line Pharma

## ERIC HALIOUA

President & Chief Executive Officer

Serial entrepreneur that combines strong strategic, technological and managerial experience with
proven track record of deal-making and fund-raising. During his career he achieved together with his
different teams to bring four drug candidates from research to the clinics (up to phase IIb).
Overall, Eric has raised as of now a total of more than €160 million from VCs and strategic partners
in Europe, USA, Japan and Korea and have had numerous successes in the sale and initial public
offering of biotechnology companies. He is CEO of the biotechnology company PDC*line Pharma and
board member of Essenscia (Bio.be). Eric is co-founder of four biotechnology companies called Myosix
(bought by Genzyme mid-2002), Murigenetics, HairClone and Digital Orthopaedics. He is co-Inventor of
the first GMP approved mobile manufacturing unit for cell therapy. Eric worked for 12 years in the
Healthcare and Life Sciences Practice of Arthur D. Little. Eric holds two master’s degrees in
pharmacology and Molecular Biology and a MBA from ESSEC business school (Paris, France), with an
advanced degree from the Health Care ESSEC chair.
[
][63]

## [ Jeff Liter ][64]

CEO

OX2 Therapeutics

## Jeff Liter

CEO

Jeff is a seasoned CEO with a proven track record at profitably growing emerging companies and
business divisions. He has raised over $15M in seed capital from angel investors to start four
different companies which he then led to becoming profitable or acquired. Jeff got his start in Cell
therapy as the Chief Operating Officer of Progenitor Cell Therapy (PCT) where he supported over 25
clinical trials in the Cell and Gene Therapy field. These trials ranged from Phase I to Phase III
pivotal trials. Some highlights include: Responsible for tech transferring Kite’s T-Cell therapy out
of the NIH, Novartis’ cell therapy out of UPenn and Adaptimmume’s cell therapy out of UPenn. Led
B-MoGen Biotechnologies to develop TcBuster the first industry wide transposon tool for the cell
therapy space. Has led Luminary Therapeutics to an approved Phase I IND for Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma
with a novel ligand CAR that has three distinct antigens – directed to overcome the 25% patient
relapse rates due to antigen escape. Has led OX2 Therapeutics to a Phase I clinical trial for
recurrent Glioblastoma.
[
][65]

## [ Alex Blyth ][66]

Founder & CEO

Lift Biosciences

## Alex Blyth

Founder & CEO

Serial entrepreneur and inventor with a background in biology and economics. Alex is a serial
entrepreneur and inventor with a background in biology and economics. With 20 years of biopharma
experience, Alex has been instrumental in bringing first-in-class assets like T-Vec, Erbitux, and
Abraxane to market. Previously, he served as Managing Director of Cello Business Sciences and
Vice-President of Cello Health Consulting. Founded LIfT BioSciences after losing his mother to
pancreatic cancer and promising his daughter they would stop other little girls losing their
grandmothers. The company builds on the research of leading immunologists Prof. Zheng Cui and Dr.
Lloyd J. Old, who identified defective neutrophils in cancer patients and demonstrated their
correction could lead to tumour remission. LIfT BioSciences has developed a new area of science
where neutrophils serve as the backbone of an effective immune system. LIfT has developed
Immuno-modulatory Alpha Neutrophils (IMANs), which infiltrate solid tumors, modulate the tumour
microenvironment, and recruit other immune cells to destroy tumours with enhanced persistence and
proliferation. The company is entering Phase 1 clinical trials for their Immuno-Cell Therapy
Platform and is exploring other therapeutic modalities, including treatments for auto-immune
diseases, neurological conditions, and infectious diseases.

Welcome to Cencora

# Find solutions that pave a reliable path to patients

Explore our full range of solutions designed to help you bring innovations to market and improve
care delivery worldwide.
[ Explore our solutions ][90]
[A light-skinned person wearing a white track jacket and a bright t-shirt jogging through a park
with the morning sun shining behind their head.]

## Distribution, commercialization, patient access, and pharmacy solutions for manufacturers,
## providers, and health systems.

We combine global capabilities and local expertise to help healthcare professionals bring
life-saving therapies, preventive treatments, and high-quality care to communities around the world.

[Logistics and warehousing][91] **

Leverage our global network to ensure safe, secure storage and timely delivery worldwide.

[ Drug research and clinical development support ][92] **

Streamline the drug development process and minimize go-to-market risk.

[ Commercialization support ][93] **

Build a foundation for a successful product launch and accelerate your speed-to-market.

[ Patient access and adherence support ][94] **

Address barriers to patient access and increase your product's speed-to-therapy.

[ Wholesale and specialty distribution ][95] **

Increase access to medications with our innovative solutions and secure supply chain.

[ Provider solutions ][96] **

Elevate the patient experience and expand care possibilities with physician practice solutions.

[ Pharmacy solutions ][97] **

Build and scale your pharmacy, accelerate growth, and deliver stronger clinical results.

[ Hospital and health system solutions ][98] **

Solve critical problems, plan for sustainable growth, and create better health outcomes.

[ Explore our capabilities ][99]

## Why Cencora

The end-to-end support we provide across the entire healthcare spectrum isn’t the only thing that
sets Cencora apart. There are so many other ways we provide a differentiated experience when you tap
into our unique capabilities.

### Global reach with local expertise

With a presence in over 50 countries, we’re expanding access to care worldwide, while our
community-level insight helps us to deploy resources effectively and efficiently.
[ Learn more about our global reach ][100]

### A commitment to innovation

Together with our industry partners, we’re continuously innovating to meet the needs of our
customers, evolving our solutions, and reshaping how healthcare is delivered.
[ Learn more about our innovation commitment ][101]

### A partner-centric  approach

We work closely with pharma companies and care providers every day, listening to their challenges
and using their insights to develop solutions that will have a positive impact on their patients.
[ Learn more about us ][102]

## What is Cencora?

It’s not easy to fully understand everything Cencora does. With countless solutions and services for
manufacturers, health systems, government entities, physician practices, pharmacies, and more, it’s
practically impossible for us to summarize what we offer without sacrificing some very important
details.

Watch this video to see some of our team members trying to define Cencora, and then check out our
stories to gain deeper insight into our business, our purpose, and our impact.

## at the speed of life.

We’re Danaher - a leading global life sciences and diagnostics innovator, committed to accelerating
the power of science and technology to improve human health.

[A microscopic image of a cell]
[A male doctor talks with a patient in a meeting room]

Our businesses
Biotechnology
[A microscopic image of a cell]

Advancements in healthcare and medicine are moving at an unprecedented pace with a promising
pipeline of innovative drugs on the horizon that are more targeted, personalized, and effective than
ever before. Our biotechnology business brings expertise, technologies, and services that accelerate
the development and commercialization of these life-changing therapies, ensuring that they can be
delivered quickly and safely to the patients who need them.

[Learn about biotechnology][66]
Diagnostics
[A male doctor talks with a patient in a meeting room]

There is an urgent need for better, more expansive health care—and we’re ready to meet it. Our
diagnostics businesses create tools and software designed to improve confidence in precise and rapid
diagnoses.

[Learn about diagnostics ][67]
Life Sciences
[Zoomed in image of a petri dish]

In a world that’s ever-changing, our customers work to advance innovations that improve human
health. Our life sciences businesses power tools and technologies that support our customers in a
wide range of critical activities, whether it’s creating breakthrough cell and gene therapies,
ensuring high-quality fluid filtration in labs, or driving the latest advances in molecular
oncology.           

[Learn about life sciences][68]

This is how Danaher brings innovation at the speed of life to the world—by connecting science,
accelerating progress, and delivering impact at global scale.

Success at Danaher doesn't happen by accident. We have a proven system for achieving it called the
Danaher Business System (DBS). DBS guides every aspect of our culture and performance. It’s how we
consistently turn ideas into impact—helping our businesses move faster, collaborate more
effectively, and deliver results with quality and certainty at scale.

[See the DBS impact][69]
[Acceleration, momentum pattern]

Our collaborative approach means we solve the hardest problems—together—with customers and partners
around the world.

#### Innovative mindset

Curiosity and continuous improvement are at Danaher’s core. We want to learn more, find new
solutions, and deliver better results. 

[See how we work][70]

We’re determined to break down silos and unite bright minds across academia and industry. Our
partnership initiatives are designed to do just that.

[See current initiatives][71]

technology to help our customers, our companies and our shareholders.

pipeline of innovative drugs on the horizon that are more targeted, personalized, and effective than
ever before. Our biotechnology business brings expertise, technologies, and services that accelerate
the development and commercialization of these life-changing therapies, ensuring that they can be
delivered quickly and safely to the patients who need them.

[Learn about biotechnology][66]
Diagnostics
[A male doctor talks with a patient in a meeting room]

There is an urgent need for better, more expansive health care—and we’re ready to meet it. Our
diagnostics businesses create tools and software designed to improve confidence in precise and rapid
diagnoses.

[Learn about diagnostics ][67]
Life Sciences
[Zoomed in image of a petri dish]

health. Our life sciences businesses power tools and technologies that support our customers in a
wide range of critical activities, whether it’s creating breakthrough cell and gene therapies,
ensuring high-quality fluid filtration in labs, or driving the latest advances in molecular
oncology.

accelerating progress, and delivering impact at global scale.

Danaher Business System (DBS). DBS guides every aspect of our culture and performance. It’s how we
consistently turn ideas into impact—helping our businesses move faster, collaborate more
effectively, and deliver results with quality and certainty at scale.

[See the DBS impact][69]

Our collaborative approach means we solve the hardest problems—together—with customers and partners
around the world.

#### Innovative mindset

Curiosity and continuous improvement are at Danaher’s core. We want to learn more, find new
solutions, and deliver better results. 

[See how we work][70]

We’re determined to break down silos and unite bright minds across academia and industry. Our

facilitating clients from all over the world and played a vital role in their success story. Our
clients include many types of organizations, the majority of which are Fortune 500 companies.

model so that the authenticity and integrity of the services are maintained. This methodology makes
sure that the analysis is comprehensive and accurate. We can provide services of importance to our
clients well within the time limit by keeping a close eye on relevant press releases, official
publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the
following: We use a variety of new, useful approaches to big data and the tools of qualitative and
quantitative marketing research to understand clients properly. The key objectives are to examine
niche markets, outline the main drivers, and indicate the most hazardous obstacles. We track major
local and global trends in this field and strive to balance the quality level within a given time
period while meeting the specialized and specialty needs of the industry.

program. With a commitment to quality, every ingredient & bottle will tell a story. It's a spot for
making memories - from date night to catch-up-time with a close friend to celebrating over countless
bottles of wine and as many dishes as you can share.

We look forward to having you over!

Gene's is a neighborhood restaurant in the heart of historic Dublin. The experience is fresh yet
familiar, sophisticated but unfussy. The menu is seasonal new-American with a wine-forward beverage
program. With a commitment to quality, every ingredient & bottle will tell a story. It's a spot for
making memories - from date night to catch-up-time with a close friend to celebrating over countless
bottles of wine and as many dishes as you can share.

We look forward to having you over!

**With our enduring gratitude… **

**Chef: Bobby Moore**

**General Manager: Michael Vehlber**

**Proprietor: Dustin Snow**
