### [2026 Nasal & Inhalation Drug Development & Delivery eBook: Drug Repurposing Creates New Market
### Opportunities][16]

In this exclusive seventh annual nasal and inhalation eBook, Drug Development & Delivery highlights
how these routes of administration are bringing new life to orphaned drugs and open new
opportunities for treatment beyond pulmonary and respiratory diseases. We also explore the
challenges of nose-to-brain delivery, next-generation propellants, overcoming the limitations of dry
powder inhalers, and successful formulation strategies.

[Featured Articles][17]

### [SPECIAL FEATURE - Outsourcing Formulation Development & Manufacturing: Connecting Your Project
### to the Right Service Provider][18]

Outsourcing formulation development and manufacturing can help drug developers address complex
dosage forms, scale-up risks, regulatory demands, and accelerated timelines by connecting projects
with CDMO partners that offer specialized expertise, integrated workflows, and scalable
manufacturing support.

[Featured Articles][19]

### [SPECIAL REPORT - Advancements in Respiratory Drug Delivery][20]

Advances in inhaled drug delivery are improving how therapies reach the lungs, with innovations in
formulations, devices, biologics, and digital tools helping expand treatment options for respiratory
diseases.

[Featured Articles][21]

### [CAR T CELL THERAPY - The Rise of Scalable Allogeneic CAR T: Shaping a New Era in Oncology][22]

Allogeneic CAR T therapies are helping move oncology toward more scalable, off-the-shelf treatment
models that could expand access, support earlier intervention, and bring advanced cell therapy
closer to community cancer settings.

[Featured Articles][23]

### [EXECUTIVE INTERVIEW - Dr. Michalis Papadakis Founder & CEO Brainomix][24]

Brainomix founder and CEO Dr. Michalis Papadakis discusses how AI-powered imaging is helping drug
developers improve clinical trial design, identify meaningful treatment effects, and advance new
therapies in stroke, pulmonary fibrosis, and other areas of unmet need.

[Featured Articles][25]

### [DRUG-DEVICE COMBINATION PRODUCTS - Incorporating Self-Administered Drug-Device Combination
### Products Into Clinical Trials Can Bring Outsized Challenges & Outstanding Rewards][26]

Self-administered drug-device combination products can bring major benefits to clinical trials,
improving patient convenience, dosing consistency, compliance, and real-world insight, but they
require careful early planning around usability, safety, regulatory requirements, compatibility,
manufacturing, and scale-up.

[Featured Articles][27]

### [DRUG DELIVERY - Improved Prediction of Food Effect on Oral Absorption][28]

Dissolution-permeation testing is helping drug developers better predict how food affects oral drug
absorption by measuring both drug solubilization and membrane permeation, reducing the risk of
misleading results from dissolution data alone.

[Featured Articles][29]

### [DRUG DEVELOPMENT - Drug Combination Screening in Oncology: Advancing Predictive Strategies for
### Precision Drug Development][30]

Drug combination screening is helping oncology developers identify synergistic drug pairs, connect
response patterns to tumor biology, and support more predictive, biomarker-guided strategies for
precision cancer treatment.

[Featured Articles][31]

### [SINGLE B CELL ANTIBODY DISCOVERY - Improving Therapeutic Candidate Selection in Drug
### Development][32]

Single B cell antibody discovery is helping improve therapeutic candidate selection by preserving
native heavy- and light-chain pairing, accelerating sequence-defined screening, and enabling earlier
identification of candidates with stronger specificity, function, and developability.

[Featured Articles][33]

### [CHEMOENZYMATIC LIGATION - Enabling Scalable, Sustainable Oligonucleotide Manufacturing][34]

Chemoenzymatic ligation offers a scalable, more sustainable path for oligonucleotide manufacturing
by combining SPOS fragment production with enzymatic assembly to improve purity, reduce impurities,
and support growing demand for nucleic acid therapeutics.

[Featured Articles][35]

### [CONTROLLED RELEASE - Precision in Every Dose: Advancing Controlled Release for Small Molecule
### Therapeutics][36]

Controlled release technologies are helping small molecule therapeutics deliver more consistent drug
exposure, improve patient adherence, reduce dosing frequency, and support more precise treatment
through advanced formulation and delivery strategies.

The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."
03
And you never see the raw data.

Here's the part nobody talks about. You get the conclusion. You don't get the spreadsheet.

**You can't check their working. You can't run your own cut. You can't take it with you when the
contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different
question than the one they answered, that's a new engagement — new invoice, new wait.

"A black box isn't analysis. It's dependency."
The data analysts use
to make their calls?
*It's right here.*

DrugPatentWatch pulls directly from primary sources — the USPTO, FDA Orange Book, ANDA filings,

eXmoor Pharma is the only integrated CGT CDMO with over 20 years of consultancy expertise embedded
across every stage of your CMC journey — from early-phase strategy to process development, GMP

## Your End-to-End Cell & Gene Therapy Partner

For over 20 years, eXmoor Pharma has been at the forefront of cell and gene therapy, supporting
biotech innovators from early-phase development to full-scale GMP manufacturing. Our unique blend of
consultancy and CDMO expertise means we don’t just manufacture—we provide strategic guidance to
ensure therapies are commercially viable from day one.

We combine CMC consultancy, process development, analytical services and GMP manufacturing to
provide comprehensive support across Viral Vectors, Autologous and Allogeneic Cell Therapies, and
RNA technologies. This integrated model enables seamless progression from early-phase strategy
through to commercial readiness.

are your long-term partner in success.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

GeneCards is a searchable, integrative database that provides comprehensive, user-friendly
information on all annotated and predicted human genes. The knowledgebase automatically integrates
gene-centric data from 193 web sources, including genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, genetic,
clinical and functional information.

# The Human Gene Database

GeneCards is a searchable, integrative database that provides comprehensive, user-friendly
information on all annotated and predicted human genes. The knowledgebase automatically integrates
gene-centric data from 193 web sources, including genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, genetic,
clinical and functional information.

Comprehensive integrated information on all annotated human genes from 193 sources.

e.g.
* NFE2L2
* MALAT1
* prostate cancer

We’re a technical and quality-focused CDMO dedicated to advancing gene and cell therapies by
providing cutting-edge viral vector services and manufacturing solutions. When you’re ready to start
or shift your CDMO journey, our team offers the expertise, technology, and flexibility to help bring
your viral vector-based therapy to patients.

#### Lentiviral Vector CDMO Services

Starting from plasmid design and cell line development all the way through to manufacturing, we
provide world-class lentiviral vector support to bring innovative therapies to fruition.

#### Retroviral Vector CDMO Services

Delivering larger batches with greater consistency and reliability, we support you with the latest
technologies from a state-of-the-art facility that is designed with the aseptic manufacture of
retroviral vectors in mind.

#### Cell Therapy CDMO Services

Leverage our world-class partnerships, streamline your production, and advance your cell therapy to
trial and beyond.

#### Plasmid Design

Whether utilizing our preferred partners’ proven platforms or working with your plasmids, we adapt
to your unique requirements, fostering collaboration for mutual success.

#### Adeno-Associated Viral Vector CDMO Services

With more than a decade’s worth of experience building diverse AAV platforms, processes, and
analytics, our team has the knowledge and skill necessary to bring your program from molecule to
medicine.

#### Collaborative Project Management

Our team is your team; dedicated partnership and flexible support that molds to your needs.

We’re a technical and quality-focused CDMO dedicated to advancing gene and cell therapies by
providing cutting-edge viral vector services and manufacturing solutions. When you’re ready to start
or shift your CDMO journey, our team offers the expertise, technology, and flexibility to help bring
your viral vector-based therapy to patients.

#### Lentiviral Vector CDMO Services

Starting from plasmid design and cell line development all the way through to manufacturing, we
provide world-class lentiviral vector support to bring innovative therapies to fruition.

#### Retroviral Vector CDMO Services

Delivering larger batches with greater consistency and reliability, we support you with the latest
technologies from a state-of-the-art facility that is designed with the aseptic manufacture of
retroviral vectors in mind.

#### Cell Therapy CDMO Services

Leverage our world-class partnerships, streamline your production, and advance your cell therapy to
trial and beyond.

#### Plasmid Design

Whether utilizing our preferred partners’ proven platforms or working with your plasmids, we adapt
to your unique requirements, fostering collaboration for mutual success.

#### Adeno-Associated Viral Vector CDMO Services

With more than a decade’s worth of experience building diverse AAV platforms, processes, and
analytics, our team has the knowledge and skill necessary to bring your program from molecule to
medicine.

#### Collaborative Project Management

Our team is your team; dedicated partnership and flexible support that molds to your needs.

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set

International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries.

## GMP+ Feed Certification scheme

The GMP+ Feed Certification (GMP+ FC) scheme provides internationally recognised standards to
produce safe feed, and a growing set of international standards for sustainable feed.

Go directly to:

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

[ Collaborations ][61]

[Our chain approach]

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

### Independent audits


GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

[ Benefits ][62]

## Subscribe to our newsletters


At GMP+ International we believe that sharing knowledge is a prerequisite for a safe and sustainable
feed chain. Please sign up for our newsletters with information about our scheme, training
opportunities, sector developments, feed legislation and more. In this way you are always informed.

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+
International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries.

The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

# Your Global Bridge to Critical Medicines

As a trusted pharmaceutical supplier since 2003, GNH India bridges the gap between the world's most
critical medicines and the patients and institutions who need them. From named patient supply and
orphan drug sourcing to clinical trial supply and government pharmaceutical programs — we deliver
with regulatory precision, cold chain integrity, and a commitment to access that goes beyond
borders.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

engaged in continuous R&D activities. For its quality production support, the firm has got approvals
from several regulatory authorities of different countries.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

By asserting our role as a responsible corporate citizen, the entire team of Hetero is playing their
part in helping the world to cope with the pandemic

[Read More][70]
[medicine in Hand] [medicine in Hand]

### Wide range of innovations; diverse and differentiated product portfolio

[Read More][71]

## At Hetero, our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of
## life-saving medicines across the world.

With unparalleled strengths in pharmaceutical research, manufacturing, and marketing, we are
positioned to serve people regardless of geographies. Our new identity embodies this drive to expand
our reach and capabilities in order to respond with agility to the world’s evolving health needs.
Our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of life-saving
medicines across the world.

## Partnering with MPP to expand access of nirmatrelvir & ritonavir generics for COVID-19 treatment

To ensure significant increase in access to COVID-19 treatments for all people, particularly those
living in the poorest parts of the world.

[Read More][72]

## Positive results in Phase III trials of Hetero’s Movfor (Molnupiravir)

Demonstrated that Molnupiravir along with Standard of Care (SOC) reduced the risk of hospitalization
by over 65% compared to SOC alone.

[Read More][73]

# We are Inizio.

Empowering health and life sciences companies to transform patients’ lives. 

[Discover what we do][197]

# Four steps to a smarter congress strategy

Transform congresses into connected strategic experiences.

[Download the guidebook][198]

# Blind spots putting your launch at risk?

Discover how InConcert™ brings clarity to launch planning.

[Learn more][199]

# STEM AI.

An AI-powered call recording and analysis solution that transforms real-world HCP interactions into
personalized coaching, actionable insights, and strategic reporting. 

[Discover STEM AI][200]

## Your global Intelligent Commercialization™ partner.

With unmatched scale and scientific expertise, we’re by your side at every stage of the clinical
development and commercialization journey – connecting data, technology, and AI with expert insight
to simplify the complex, unlock value, and realize your product’s potential.

[Learn more][201]

## For every pivotal moment in your product’s lifecycle.

From your earliest breakthroughs to loss of exclusivity, we’ll put an experienced, connected team
right at your fingertips, helping you achieve insight-driven, tech-enabled results at scale.

[Tap to view Discovery]
[Background image for Discovery]

### Discovery

Exploring your opportunities with expert market research and strategy consulting.

[Tap to view Development]
[Background image for Development]

### Development

Advancing your asset through development with integrated scientific strategy, stakeholder
engagement, and communications expertise.

[Tap to view Pre-launch]
[Background image for Pre-launch]

### Pre-launch

Building your evidence base and getting powerful data to pivotal decision-makers.

[Tap to view Launch]
[Background image for Launch]

### Launch

Making maximum impact from day one, with a robust sales and engagement strategy.

[Tap to view Post-launch]
[Background image for Post-launch]

### Post-launch

Driving lasting impact through experiences, medical education, patient services, and analytics.

## Global scale. Proven results.

By maximizing asset value at every opportunity, we drive measurable and lasting results that deliver
value for our clients.

>
experts across 50 countries
PhDs & 800 nurses on your team
>
pharma & biotech clients worldwide
%
of top 20 pharma as clients (WW Rx sales 2025-2027)

## Best-in-class experts, by your side.

Commercialization is a complex journey, which is why we bring you a team of talented experts trusted
by every top 20 pharma company in the world. 

### Deep, broad expertise.

With unmatched scale and scientific understanding, we pair multidisciplinary human expertise with AI
innovation to get life-changing products to patients faster.

### Solutions to every challenge.

We start with the challenges you face, creating tailored solutions powered by proprietary tech that
deliver exactly the support you need, every step of the way.

### People you’ll love working with.

We build real, lasting partnerships through a single point of contact, a dedicated account team,
rigorous governance, and seamless project delivery.

### Innovation that underpins everything.

We combine proprietary technology, AI, and human insight to deliver Intelligent Commercialization™ –
accelerating lasting impact for you and your patients.

[Get in touch][202]

## Specialized expertise,
## seamlessly connected.

Each of our five industry-leading businesses brings a deep and broad set of capabilities. Work with
one, several, or all – in the way that best supports your goals.

#### Data Sources

#### Detailed Market Analysis

The pharmaceutical industry is undergoing a remarkable digital transformation, supported by concrete
market research and verified statistics. The scale of this transformation is evidenced by the
pharmaceutical digital platform market’s projected growth from $4.92 billion in 2023 to $34.12
billion by 2032, representing a robust CAGR of 24.35%. This growth is driven by widespread cloud
adoption, with approximately 80% of pharmaceutical companies already utilizing cloud computing
solutions and 95% expected to be fully cloud-operational within two years.

The transformation is happening across multiple dimensions, with web-based solutions dominating at
72.27% market share and AI-driven engagement representing 27.05% of patient engagement solutions.
Quality management systems are also evolving, with the market expected to grow from $1.87 billion in
2024 to $3.85 billion by 2030 at a CAGR of 12.99%. This digital evolution is particularly strong in
North America, which holds a 43.6% share in patient engagement solutions and 39% of the quality
management software market. Implementation timelines vary by solution complexity, ranging from 3-6
months for modular SaaS deployments to 9-18 months for full-suite implementations, reflecting the
industry’s methodical approach to digital adoption while maintaining compliance with regulatory
requirements.

#### Detailed Market Analysis

The pharmaceutical industry is undergoing a remarkable digital transformation, supported by concrete
market research and verified statistics. The scale of this transformation is evidenced by the
pharmaceutical digital platform market’s projected growth from $4.92 billion in 2023 to $34.12
billion by 2032, representing a robust CAGR of 24.35%. This growth is driven by widespread cloud
adoption, with approximately 80% of pharmaceutical companies already utilizing cloud computing
solutions and 95% expected to be fully cloud-operational within two years.

The transformation is happening across multiple dimensions, with web-based solutions dominating at
72.27% market share and AI-driven engagement representing 27.05% of patient engagement solutions.
Quality management systems are also evolving, with the market expected to grow from $1.87 billion in
2024 to $3.85 billion by 2030 at a CAGR of 12.99%. This digital evolution is particularly strong in
North America, which holds a 43.6% share in patient engagement solutions and 39% of the quality
management software market. Implementation timelines vary by solution complexity, ranging from 3-6
months for modular SaaS deployments to 9-18 months for full-suite implementations, reflecting the
industry’s methodical approach to digital adoption while maintaining compliance with regulatory
requirements.

## Built for businesses that need both filings and strategy

Most businesses in India choose between two kinds of partner. Filing platforms are fast and cheap,
but they will not advise you on a market entry, a transaction, or an audit. Boutique consulting
firms are strong on strategy, but they will not file your GSTR-3B or push your DIR-3 KYC. KAMRIT
does both.

That works because KAMRIT is structured as a financial services LLP with capability across
registration, tax, audit, and corporate compliance, and it operates alongside our sister firm
Claight (same directors, same shareholders) which publishes research, analytics, and procurement
intelligence across nineteen industries. Filings flow into advisory. Advisory flows into filings.
One partner is accountable.

## What that gets you
* **Volume work without the platform cost.** Private Limited Company registration starts at ₹4,899.
  GST returns from ₹699 a month. Trademark filing at ₹4,899. All fixed fee.
* **Strategic work without the Big-Four price.** India entry, feasibility studies, GTM strategy,
  M&A, and transfer pricing engagements led by senior partners.
* **Research at your shoulder.** Claight market intelligence informs our India entry and GTM work,
  used by clients across SaaS, manufacturing, healthcare, and consumer goods.
* **A single calendar across regulators.** ROC, FEMA, RBI, GST, Income Tax, PF, ESI, Shops Act, all
  owned, filed, and reported on monthly.

Frequently asked

## Quick answers from our experts.

What services does KAMRIT offer?

KAMRIT offers the complete India advisory stack. Company registration (Private Limited, LLP, OPC,
Section 8, Producer, Nidhi), GST registration and returns, income tax and TDS, MCA and ROC
compliance, trademark and IP, payroll and labour, audit and assurance, plus India entry, GTM
strategy, M&A advisory, and FEMA / RBI work.

How is KAMRIT different from IndiaFilings or a typical CA firm?

Two ways. First, we run both the filings (like a platform) and the strategic advisory (like a
consulting firm) under one roof, so a Private Limited Company registration can flow into a GTM
strategy and an audited annual return without changing vendors. Second, KAMRIT and our sister firm
Claight share directors and shareholders, which means our India entry, market sizing, and
procurement intelligence work sits on top of the same research feeds Fortune 500 strategy and
procurement teams already use.

How much does company registration cost in India?

KAMRIT registers a Private Limited Company starting at ₹4,899, an LLP starting at ₹3,899, a One
Person Company at ₹3,899, and a Sole Proprietorship at ₹1,899. Pricing is fixed-fee and inclusive of
MCA name approval, MOA and AOA drafting, incorporation, PAN, TAN, and bank account opening
assistance.

How long does GST registration take?

A standard GST registration takes seven to ten working days from document submission, subject to the
GSTN officer's processing time. KAMRIT files within one business day of receiving complete documents
and tracks every notification end to end.

intelligence across nineteen industries. Filings flow into advisory. Advisory flows into filings.

Frequently asked

## Quick answers from our experts.

What services does KAMRIT offer?

KAMRIT offers the complete India advisory stack. Company registration (Private Limited, LLP, OPC,
Section 8, Producer, Nidhi), GST registration and returns, income tax and TDS, MCA and ROC
compliance, trademark and IP, payroll and labour, audit and assurance, plus India entry, GTM
strategy, M&A advisory, and FEMA / RBI work.

How is KAMRIT different from IndiaFilings or a typical CA firm?

Two ways. First, we run both the filings (like a platform) and the strategic advisory (like a
consulting firm) under one roof, so a Private Limited Company registration can flow into a GTM
strategy and an audited annual return without changing vendors. Second, KAMRIT and our sister firm
Claight share directors and shareholders, which means our India entry, market sizing, and
procurement intelligence work sits on top of the same research feeds Fortune 500 strategy and
procurement teams already use.

How much does company registration cost in India?

KAMRIT registers a Private Limited Company starting at ₹4,899, an LLP starting at ₹3,899, a One
Person Company at ₹3,899, and a Sole Proprietorship at ₹1,899. Pricing is fixed-fee and inclusive of
MCA name approval, MOA and AOA drafting, incorporation, PAN, TAN, and bank account opening
assistance.

How long does GST registration take?

A standard GST registration takes seven to ten working days from document submission, subject to the
GSTN officer's processing time. KAMRIT files within one business day of receiving complete documents
and tracks every notification end to end.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

# Making the Medicines of Tomorrow

As a dedicated CDMO serving the healthcare industry, we bring life-enhancing and life-saving
treatments to market for our customers and their patients. We are a pioneer and world leader in the
CDMO industry, setting the pace with cutting-edge science, smart technology, and lean manufacturing.
United by a common purpose, we turn our customers’ breakthrough innovations into viable therapies
and manufacture the medicines of tomorrow.

Founded in Switzerland in 1897, our company is the first and original CDMO. Today, we bring together
a team of 20,000 colleagues across five continents to deliver integrated offerings that meet the
complex needs of our global customer community.

# Making the Medicines of Tomorrow

As a dedicated CDMO serving the healthcare industry, we bring life-enhancing and life-saving
treatments to market for our customers and their patients. We are a pioneer and world leader in the
CDMO industry, setting the pace with cutting-edge science, smart technology, and lean manufacturing.
United by a common purpose, we turn our customers’ breakthrough innovations into viable therapies
and manufacture the medicines of tomorrow.

Founded in Switzerland in 1897, our company is the first and original CDMO. Today, we bring together
a team of 20,000 colleagues across five continents to deliver integrated offerings that meet the
complex needs of our global customer community.

## **Cleanroom Projects**

 

[[Modular Cleanroom Showroom]][63]

### **Vaccine Manufacturing Facility**

MECART was tasked with creating 14,000 square feet of Class B, C, and D clean rooms that adhered to
GMP standards for vaccine development. The entire facility was delivered in less than 10 months!

room, and multiple material airlocks (MAL) and personal airlocks (PAL).

[View this medical device cleanroom case study][66]
[[Modular Cleanroom Showroom (2)]][67]

cleanroom) for PCB and SMT manufacturing, technologies that will change the electric car sector.

[View this semiconductor cleanroom case study][68]
[[Modular Cleanroom Showroom (3)]][69]

laboratories, an ISO 7 master cell banking cleanroom, and an ISO 8 gowning room.

[View this biotech cleanroom case study][70]
[[Modular Cleanroom Showroom (4)]][71]

The prefab modular hospital needed several isolation rooms, 36 prefab individual patient rooms
spread over 2 floors. The isolation rooms were designed for an immuno-oncology center that treats
cancer patients.

[View this healthcare cleanroom case study][72]
[[Modular Cleanroom Showroom (5)]][73]

### **503B Cleanroom for Outsourcing and Repackaging Facility**

The 503B compounding pharmacy operates under an ISO 7 cleanliness level with an ISO 8 background
zone.

[View the 503B cleanroom case study][74]

laboratories, an ISO 7 master cell banking cleanroom, and an ISO 8 gowning room.

[View this biotech cleanroom case study][70]

The prefab modular hospital needed several isolation rooms, 36 prefab individual patient rooms
spread over 2 floors. The isolation rooms were designed for an immuno-oncology center that treats
cancer patients.

[View this healthcare cleanroom case study][72]
[[Modular Cleanroom Showroom (5)]][73]

The 503B compounding pharmacy operates under an ISO 7 cleanliness level with an ISO 8 background
zone.

[View the 503B cleanroom case study][74]

# CDMO services to actualize your cell and gene therapy program

## Press release

Miltenyi Biotec and CHA Biotech collaborate on BaEV lentiviral vector platform to enhance CAR NK 
manufacturing efficiency

[Read the full press release][32]

## Upcoming event

ISCT Asia 2026 Regional Meeting
September 2-5, 2026, Singapore

 

[See all news and upcoming events][33]

## We have manufactured over 900 GMP cell therapy batches, helping our clients treat patients all
## around the world

## We have manufactured over 350 batches of GMP lentiviral vector to support over 100 clinical
## trials

## With regulatory experience in over 45 countries, we help you get your therapy to patients,
## wherever they may be


## Your full-service CDMO partner

Miltenyi Bioindustry supports all efforts, from pre-clinical to commercial scale, as a
full-service provider for the development and manufacturing of lentiviral vectors (LVVs) and cell
and gene therapy (CGT) products. As a globally active CDMO (Contract Development and Manufacturing
Organization) with 25 years of extensive know-how, we are helping to shape this rapidly growing
arena.  We leverage the latest technology platforms to make your vision of commercial-scale
manufacturing a reality. We are a division of Miltenyi Biotec, a pioneering innovator and provider
of cell processing and analytical platforms, LVVs, and ancillary materials in this field.




## Cell and gene therapy process development and manufacturing

We make your product ready for clinical trials and towards commercial roll-out. Miltenyi Biotec’s
proven manufacturing and analysis platforms comprise closed and integrated solutions that help
advance your process to commercial scale.
 

[Our cell therapy services][34]


## Lentiviral vector optimization and manufacturing

From LVV design and selection to small-scale evaluation and commercial-scale manufacturing, we
support customers at various scales. With decades of experience and a scalable LVV platform, we
offer fast and consistent production of high-quality vectors with minimal process development.
 

[Our LVV services][35]






## Regulatory support services

Our global quality and regulatory teams support your project from pre-IND to market approval. We
have the experience and the documentation to accelerate your regulatory submissions.
 

[Our regulatory support][36]


## Our mission

Our mission is to improve the availability and affordability of advanced CGT products. We do so by
providing solutions that propel manufacturing of cell therapies for translation into the clinic and
the market. We provide services, expertise, and technologies to leading researchers, biotech
companies, and large corporates to take their cell and gene therapy products to the next level.


## Contact us  

Ready to start your CGT journey? 
Contact our experts to find out what solutions we have to offer to you. 

[Contact our experts][37]

Miltenyi Biotec and CHA Biotech collaborate on BaEV lentiviral vector platform to enhance CAR NK 
manufacturing efficiency

[Read the full press release][32]

## Upcoming event

ISCT Asia 2026 Regional Meeting
September 2-5, 2026, Singapore

 

[See all news and upcoming events][33]

## We have manufactured over 900 GMP cell therapy batches, helping our clients treat patients all
## around the world

## We have manufactured over 350 batches of GMP lentiviral vector to support over 100 clinical
## trials

## With regulatory experience in over 45 countries, we help you get your therapy to patients,
## wherever they may be


## Your full-service CDMO partner

Miltenyi Bioindustry supports all efforts, from pre-clinical to commercial scale, as a
full-service provider for the development and manufacturing of lentiviral vectors (LVVs) and cell
and gene therapy (CGT) products. As a globally active CDMO (Contract Development and Manufacturing
Organization) with 25 years of extensive know-how, we are helping to shape this rapidly growing
arena.  We leverage the latest technology platforms to make your vision of commercial-scale
manufacturing a reality. We are a division of Miltenyi Biotec, a pioneering innovator and provider
of cell processing and analytical platforms, LVVs, and ancillary materials in this field.




## Cell and gene therapy process development and manufacturing

We make your product ready for clinical trials and towards commercial roll-out. Miltenyi Biotec’s
proven manufacturing and analysis platforms comprise closed and integrated solutions that help
advance your process to commercial scale.
 

[Our cell therapy services][34]


## Lentiviral vector optimization and manufacturing

From LVV design and selection to small-scale evaluation and commercial-scale manufacturing, we
support customers at various scales. With decades of experience and a scalable LVV platform, we
offer fast and consistent production of high-quality vectors with minimal process development.
 

[Our LVV services][35]






## Regulatory support services

Our global quality and regulatory teams support your project from pre-IND to market approval. We
have the experience and the documentation to accelerate your regulatory submissions.
 

[Our regulatory support][36]


## Our mission

Our mission is to improve the availability and affordability of advanced CGT products. We do so by
providing solutions that propel manufacturing of cell therapies for translation into the clinic and
the market. We provide services, expertise, and technologies to leading researchers, biotech
companies, and large corporates to take their cell and gene therapy products to the next level.


## Contact us  

Ready to start your CGT journey? 
Contact our experts to find out what solutions we have to offer to you. 

[Contact our experts][37]

# Every Breakthrough
# Begins with Belief

[decorative diamond pattern]

**Gene therapy holds incredible promise** to revolutionize medical treatment. At Neurogene we
believe that innovation, robust scientific execution and a strong sense of purpose are required to
turn this promise into reality. Our focus is to develop life-changing genetic medicines for people
and their families impacted by devastating neurological diseases.

[**Get to know our story**][35]

## A passion for serving patients and their families

We listen to patients and families and incorporate their perspectives into our work, striving to
support them throughout our research and development process and beyond.

[See how we are making a difference][36]

## Gene therapies for rare neurological disorders

We are advancing a gene therapy pipeline to help address the high unmet need for rare neurological
diseases, with a focus on Rett syndrome.

[Learn about NGN-401 Gene Therapy][37]

## A differentiated platform technology

We leverage our proprietary transgene regulation technology to open up new possibilities for rare
neurological diseases.

[Learn about our EXACT™ technology][38]
[Girl with Rett syndrome]

### Pursuing a Brighter Future, Together

We own our responsibility to provide transparent updates on our progress on an ongoing basis to
those in the patient communities we serve. This partnership is critical to advance a potential
one-time treatment for a rare neurodevelopmental disorder like Rett syndrome.

[**Read Our Community Letters**][39]

## Patients and families are at the core of our work.

We recognize and honor that it is their contributions that make scientific advances possible. We
strive to support them throughout their participation in clinical research.

### Rachel McMinn, Ph.D.

*Founder and Chief Executive Officer*

[Rachel McMinn Ph.D. - Founder and Chief Executive Officer]Rachel McMinn, Ph.D., is Chief Executive
Officer of Neurogene and serves as Executive Chair of the company’s Board of Directors. She founded
Neurogene in January 2018 with the mission of developing genetic medicines to improve the lives of
neurologically-impaired people and their families. Prior to founding Neurogene, Dr. McMinn served as
the Chief Business and Strategy Officer of Intercept Pharmaceuticals, a company dedicated to
patients with serious liver disease. Prior to her industry experience, Dr. McMinn was an
award-winning biotechnology analyst, with 13 years of experience at firms including Bank of America
Merrill Lynch, Cowen, and Piper Jaffray. She graduated from Cornell University magna cum laude with
a B.A. and earned her Ph.D. from The Scripps Research Institute and was awarded a Post-Doctoral
Miller Fellowship at the University of California, Berkeley.

×

### Christine Mikail, J.D.

*President and Chief Financial Officer*

[Christine Mikail, J.D. President and Chief Financial Officer]Christine Mikail, J.D., is President
and Chief Financial Officer of Neurogene and serves on the company’s Board of Directors. In her
role, Ms. Mikail leads Corporate Strategy and Business Development, Portfolio Management,
Operations, and Finance. Ms. Mikail, who joined Neurogene in 2019, brings over two decades of
experience supporting biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies in corporate strategy and business
development, operations, legal and finance capacities. Prior to Neurogene, Ms. Mikail was Chief
Administrative Officer and Head of External Business Development/Alliance Management and General
Counsel at Axovant Sciences, Inc., where she was an integral member of the team that raised $362
million in the company’s IPO. Prior to joining Axovant, she held a variety of senior executive
positions at NPS Pharmaceuticals, Inc., Dendreon Corporation, Eli Lilly and Company, and ImClone
Systems. Ms. Mikail developed her life sciences focus as a corporate and securities lawyer at Reed
Smith and WilmerHale. Ms. Mikail graduated cum laude with a B.A. from Rutgers University and earned
her J.D. from Fordham University School of Law in New York.

×

### Andrew Mulberg, M.D.

*Senior Vice President, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, and Quality Control*

[Andrew Mulberg, M.D. - Senior Vice President, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, and Quality
Control]Andrew Mulberg, M.D., serves as Senior Vice President, Regulatory Affairs, Quality
Assurance, and Quality Control at Neurogene. Dr. Mulberg is a pediatric gastroenterologist with
nearly 30 years of experience and has a strong passion for helping bring important new medicines to
market for patients with devastating rare diseases. In his role at Neurogene, he provides strategic
leadership and direction for regulatory and quality activities. Prior to joining Neurogene, Dr.
Mulberg led global regulatory affairs for Amicus Therapeutics and held various roles of increasing
responsibility within global drug development and medical affairs at Johnson & Johnson. In addition
to Dr. Mulberg’s biotechnology and pharmaceutical experience, he spent six years as the Division
Deputy Director in the Division of Gastroenterology and Inborn Errors Products at the U.S. FDA. He
received his B.A. from Columbia University and his M.D. from Mount Sinai School of Medicine. Dr.
Mulberg also previously served as Attending Physician and Fellowship Director of Gastroenterology
and Hepatology at Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia. He is currently an adjunct Professor of
Pediatrics at the University of Maryland Medical Center, and Chairman of the Medical Advisory Board
Go4 the Goal foundation, a pediatric cancer advocacy 501(c)(3) organization.

×

### Stuart Cobb, Ph.D.

*Chief Scientific Officer*

[Stuart Cobb, Ph.D. - Chief Scientific Officer]Stuart Cobb, Ph.D., is Chief Scientific Officer at
Neurogene. Dr. Cobb, who joined Neurogene in 2019, brings to the team more than 20 years of
experience in translational neuroscience. He leads Neurogene’s scientific research, the development
of scientific strategy to support the company’s existing and growing gene therapy portfolio, and
efforts to identify novel technologies that complement Neurogene’s pipeline. In addition to his role
at Neurogene, Dr. Cobb also leads a research team at the University of Edinburgh, where he is
Professor of Translational Neuroscience at Simons Initiative in the Developing Brain and Centre for
Discovery Brain Sciences. Prior to his work at Neurogene, Dr. Cobb was a Caledonian Research Fellow
and led an academic research laboratory at the University of Glasgow. His research has focused on
developing novel genetic treatments for brain disorders based on a deep understanding of the
molecular and cellular pathology. Dr. Cobb’s work has been published in leading journals and
includes seminal work on the inherent reversibility of neurological features in neurodevelopmental
disease. Dr. Cobb has a B.Sc. from the University of Glasgow and a Ph.D. in Neuroscience from the
University of Oxford.

×

### Donna M. Cochener, J.D., LL.M.

*Senior Vice President and General Counsel*

[Donna M. Cochener, J.D., LL.M. - Senior Vice President and General Counsel]Donna M. Cochener, J.D.,
LL.M., is Senior Vice President and General Counsel of Neurogene. She is a seasoned legal and
executive professional with over two decades of experience in corporate law, governance, and
executive leadership across the biotechnology and financial services sectors. Prior to joining
Neurogene, Ms. Cochener held the roles of Interim Chief Executive Officer and General Counsel at
Neoleukin Therapeutics, where she led the company through its merger with Neurogene in December
2023. Her earlier career includes serving as Senior Vice President and Deputy General Counsel at
HomeStreet, Inc., the parent company of HomeStreet Bank, where she was primarily responsible for
securities reporting and compliance, corporate governance, and led various transactions including
mergers and acquisitions. Ms. Cochener was previously a partner at Davis Wright Tremaine LLP in
Seattle, and also held associate positions at Heller Ehrman LLP, Riddell Williams P.S., and Perkins
Coie LLP.

×

### Julie Jordan, M.D.

*Chief Medical Officer*

[Julie Jordan, M.D. - Chief Medical Officer]Julie Jordan, M.D., is Chief Medical Officer at
Neurogene. Dr. Jordan brings over 20 years of industry and clinical expertise involving the design
and execution of global clinical trials across multiple development areas, including gene therapy
and central nervous system disorders. Before joining Neurogene, she was Chief Medical Officer at
Homology Medicines, where she was responsible for leading clinical development and operations,
leading regulatory interactions and supporting translational research programs for the company’s
pipeline of gene therapy and gene editing candidates for rare diseases. She previously held global
leadership roles of increasing responsibility at Cerevel Therapeutics, Avanir Pharmaceuticals and
Teva Pharmaceutical Industries. Prior to her industry experience, Dr. Jordan was a practicing
physician for 10 years and previously served as Clinical Instructor of Medicine at Harvard Medical
School and in the Department of Medicine at Massachusetts General Hospital (MGH). She holds an A.B.
in Biology from Harvard College and an M.D. from Harvard Medical School and completed her residency
in Internal Medicine at MGH, Harvard Medical School.

### Rachel McMinn, Ph.D.

*Founder and Chief Executive Officer*

[Rachel McMinn Ph.D. - Founder and Chief Executive Officer]Rachel McMinn, Ph.D., is Chief Executive
Officer of Neurogene and serves as Executive Chair of the company’s Board of Directors. She founded
Neurogene in January 2018 with the mission of developing genetic medicines to improve the lives of
neurologically-impaired people and their families. Prior to founding Neurogene, Dr. McMinn served as
the Chief Business and Strategy Officer of Intercept Pharmaceuticals, a company dedicated to
patients with serious liver disease. Prior to her industry experience, Dr. McMinn was an
award-winning biotechnology analyst, with 13 years of experience at firms including Bank of America
Merrill Lynch, Cowen, and Piper Jaffray. She graduated from Cornell University magna cum laude with
a B.A. and earned her Ph.D. from The Scripps Research Institute and was awarded a Post-Doctoral
Miller Fellowship at the University of California, Berkeley.

×

### Christine Mikail, J.D.

*President and Chief Financial Officer*

[Christine Mikail, J.D. President and Chief Financial Officer]Christine Mikail, J.D., is President
and Chief Financial Officer of Neurogene and serves on the company’s Board of Directors. In her
role, Ms. Mikail leads Corporate Strategy and Business Development, Portfolio Management,
Operations, and Finance. Ms. Mikail, who joined Neurogene in 2019, brings over two decades of
experience supporting biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies in corporate strategy and business
development, operations, legal and finance capacities. Prior to Neurogene, Ms. Mikail was Chief
Administrative Officer and Head of External Business Development/Alliance Management and General
Counsel at Axovant Sciences, Inc., where she was an integral member of the team that raised $362
million in the company’s IPO. Prior to joining Axovant, she held a variety of senior executive
positions at NPS Pharmaceuticals, Inc., Dendreon Corporation, Eli Lilly and Company, and ImClone
Systems. Ms. Mikail developed her life sciences focus as a corporate and securities lawyer at Reed
Smith and WilmerHale. Ms. Mikail graduated cum laude with a B.A. from Rutgers University and earned
her J.D. from Fordham University School of Law in New York.

×

### Andrew Mulberg, M.D.

*Senior Vice President, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, and Quality Control*

[Andrew Mulberg, M.D. - Senior Vice President, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, and Quality
Control]Andrew Mulberg, M.D., serves as Senior Vice President, Regulatory Affairs, Quality
Assurance, and Quality Control at Neurogene. Dr. Mulberg is a pediatric gastroenterologist with
nearly 30 years of experience and has a strong passion for helping bring important new medicines to
market for patients with devastating rare diseases. In his role at Neurogene, he provides strategic
leadership and direction for regulatory and quality activities. Prior to joining Neurogene, Dr.
Mulberg led global regulatory affairs for Amicus Therapeutics and held various roles of increasing
responsibility within global drug development and medical affairs at Johnson & Johnson. In addition
to Dr. Mulberg’s biotechnology and pharmaceutical experience, he spent six years as the Division
Deputy Director in the Division of Gastroenterology and Inborn Errors Products at the U.S. FDA. He
received his B.A. from Columbia University and his M.D. from Mount Sinai School of Medicine. Dr.
Mulberg also previously served as Attending Physician and Fellowship Director of Gastroenterology
and Hepatology at Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia. He is currently an adjunct Professor of
Pediatrics at the University of Maryland Medical Center, and Chairman of the Medical Advisory Board
Go4 the Goal foundation, a pediatric cancer advocacy 501(c)(3) organization.

×

### Stuart Cobb, Ph.D.

*Chief Scientific Officer*

[Stuart Cobb, Ph.D. - Chief Scientific Officer]Stuart Cobb, Ph.D., is Chief Scientific Officer at
Neurogene. Dr. Cobb, who joined Neurogene in 2019, brings to the team more than 20 years of
experience in translational neuroscience. He leads Neurogene’s scientific research, the development
of scientific strategy to support the company’s existing and growing gene therapy portfolio, and
efforts to identify novel technologies that complement Neurogene’s pipeline. In addition to his role
at Neurogene, Dr. Cobb also leads a research team at the University of Edinburgh, where he is
Professor of Translational Neuroscience at Simons Initiative in the Developing Brain and Centre for
Discovery Brain Sciences. Prior to his work at Neurogene, Dr. Cobb was a Caledonian Research Fellow
and led an academic research laboratory at the University of Glasgow. His research has focused on
developing novel genetic treatments for brain disorders based on a deep understanding of the
molecular and cellular pathology. Dr. Cobb’s work has been published in leading journals and
includes seminal work on the inherent reversibility of neurological features in neurodevelopmental
disease. Dr. Cobb has a B.Sc. from the University of Glasgow and a Ph.D. in Neuroscience from the
University of Oxford.

×

[Donna M. Cochener, J.D., LL.M. - Senior Vice President and General Counsel]Donna M. Cochener, J.D.,
LL.M., is Senior Vice President and General Counsel of Neurogene. She is a seasoned legal and
executive professional with over two decades of experience in corporate law, governance, and
executive leadership across the biotechnology and financial services sectors. Prior to joining
Neurogene, Ms. Cochener held the roles of Interim Chief Executive Officer and General Counsel at
Neoleukin Therapeutics, where she led the company through its merger with Neurogene in December
2023. Her earlier career includes serving as Senior Vice President and Deputy General Counsel at
HomeStreet, Inc., the parent company of HomeStreet Bank, where she was primarily responsible for
securities reporting and compliance, corporate governance, and led various transactions including
mergers and acquisitions. Ms. Cochener was previously a partner at Davis Wright Tremaine LLP in
Seattle, and also held associate positions at Heller Ehrman LLP, Riddell Williams P.S., and Perkins
Coie LLP.

Homology Medicines, where she was responsible for leading clinical development and operations,
leading regulatory interactions and supporting translational research programs for the company’s

FAQ

Trusted Answers for Your Medical Courier Needs

Healthcare doesn't wait, and neither do we. Find clear answers about our medical delivery services,
nationwide coverage, and 24/7 scheduling options.
* 1. What services do you offer?
  
  Night & Day Logistics specializes in 24/7/365 courier and logistics services, including:
  * Medical Logistics: Transport of specimens, blood products, pharmaceuticals, and surgical
    instruments.
  * White Glove Service: Elevated assistance for crating, packaging, and shipping fragile items.
  * Temperature Controlled Transport: For sensitive medical or research items.
  * Next Flight Out (NFO): Rush delivery to airlines for domestic and international destinations.
  * Last Mile & On-Demand: Same-day delivery services.
  
  ## 24/7/365
* 2. What items are prohibited from transport?
  
  We do not transport the following items:
  * Cash, bullion, or bearer bonds.
  * Firearms or explosives.
  * Illegal drugs or contraband.
* 3. What are my responsibilities as a shipper?
  
  To ensure successful delivery, clients are required to:
  * Provide Accurate Info: Complete details on pick-up/delivery addresses, contact names, package
    weight/dimensions and content.
  * Pack Properly: Items must be securely packed to withstand normal handling. The company is not
    liable for damage caused by improper packaging.
  * Be Ready: Shipments must be ready for pick-up at the scheduled time to avoid deliver delays and
    additional fees.
* 4. What is your liability policy for lost or damaged goods?
  * Standard Liability: Limited to $100.00 USD per shipment unless a higher value is declared and
    additional insurance is purchased prior to shipment.
  * Claims: All claims for damage or loss must be submitted in writing within 15 days of the
    delivery date (or scheduled delivery date for losses).

We Will Ensure It Gets To The Right Person

At Night & Day Logistics, accuracy and accountability are at the core of every delivery.

materials, and sensitive documents are delivered directly to the intended recipient securely and
without delay.


From hospital corridors to laboratory handoffs, we make sure every item reaches the right person,

[Learn More About Our Mission ][52]
FAQ

Trusted Answers for Your Medical Courier Needs

Healthcare doesn't wait, and neither do we. Find clear answers about our medical delivery services,
nationwide coverage, and 24/7 scheduling options.
* 1. What services do you offer?
  
  Night & Day Logistics specializes in 24/7/365 courier and logistics services, including:
  * Medical Logistics: Transport of specimens, blood products, pharmaceuticals, and surgical
    instruments.
  * White Glove Service: Elevated assistance for crating, packaging, and shipping fragile items.
  * Temperature Controlled Transport: For sensitive medical or research items.
  * Next Flight Out (NFO): Rush delivery to airlines for domestic and international destinations.
  * Last Mile & On-Demand: Same-day delivery services.
  
  ## 24/7/365
* 2. What items are prohibited from transport?
  
  We do not transport the following items:
  * Cash, bullion, or bearer bonds.
  * Firearms or explosives.
  * Illegal drugs or contraband.
* 3. What are my responsibilities as a shipper?
  
  To ensure successful delivery, clients are required to:
  * Provide Accurate Info: Complete details on pick-up/delivery addresses, contact names, package
    weight/dimensions and content.
  * Pack Properly: Items must be securely packed to withstand normal handling. The company is not
    liable for damage caused by improper packaging.
  * Be Ready: Shipments must be ready for pick-up at the scheduled time to avoid deliver delays and
    additional fees.
* 4. What is your liability policy for lost or damaged goods?
  * Standard Liability: Limited to $100.00 USD per shipment unless a higher value is declared and
    additional insurance is purchased prior to shipment.
  * Claims: All claims for damage or loss must be submitted in writing within 15 days of the
    delivery date (or scheduled delivery date for losses).
* 5. Do you offer tracking?
  
  Yes. The company utilizes technology for Online Track & Trace, auto notifications via Email/SMS,
  and GPS access to drivers to ensure visibility of your shipment.

# Manufacturing Excellence for Transformative Therapies

## Your Lifelong Cell and Gene Therapy CDMO Partner

[ Explore Our Services ][68]

## Bringing Your Cell and Gene Therapy to Life

Selecting a cell and gene therapy contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) partner
is critical. At OmniaBio, we revolutionize cell and gene therapy manufacturing to enhance the
affordability and accessibility of treatments. With decades of collective experience in both
autologous and allogeneic cell therapies, we navigate the complexities of process development and
GMP manufacturing to advance your program efficiently.

Our dedication to innovation and collaboration ensures that we are not just a CGT CDMO, but a true
innovation partner in bringing your groundbreaking therapies to life for patients in need.

[ Request A Consult ][69]
[commercial-capacity-logo]
Early development to commercial capacity
[flex-scalable-updated]
Flexible, scalable technology solutions
[ai-manufacturing-icon]
AI-enabled development and GMP manufacturing

## Seamless Transition from Early Development to Commercial Supply

Our expertise in advanced manufacturing services ensures the reliable execution needed to propel
your program forward. Our comprehensive suite of services seamlessly merges technical proficiency in
cell-based processes and gene delivery tools with cutting-edge advancements in process development
and manufacturing. This integration provides holistic capabilities that span the entire product
lifecycle – from preclinical development to large-scale commercial manufacturing.
With a variety of GMP suite options (Grade B or Grade C), we deliver GMP manufacturing of cell
therapies that comply with U.S., Canadian, and European regulations. Trust us to guide your journey
toward compliant, scalable, and cost-effective manufacturing.

## Advancing Autologous Cell Therapies with Robust, Scalable Solutions

With over a decade of experience developing immune cell-based therapy processes, our team of
technical experts specializes in developing and optimizing manufacturing platforms. We integrate
closed-unit systems, AI models, and robotics to create robust, scalable, and efficient processes
tailored to your needs.

#### Process Development

Process development and optimization expertise for enhanced robustness and reliable scale-up.
[ Explore Process Development ][70]

#### Analytical Development

Comprehensive analytical development services for tailored and established assays.
[ EXPLORE ANALYTICAL DEVELOPMENT ][71]

#### Autologous Manufacturing

Hamilton Intelligent Facility: AI and robotics integration for enhanced production rates and reduced
costs.
[ EXPLORE AUTOLOGOUS MANUFACTURING ][72]

#### Platform Expertise

Cutting-edge cell platforms for lentiviral vector-, immune cell- and iPSC-based therapies.
[ EXPLORE OUR PLATFORMS ][73]

#### GMP Manufacturing

Resilient manufacturing for consistent quality, certified compliance, and minimal risks at every
stage.
[ EXPLORE GMP MANUFACTURING ][74]

#### Commercial Manufacturing

Efficient scalability, timely QC release, and reliable delivery to support your commercial goals.
[ EXPLORE COMMERCIAL MANUFACTURING ][75]
